notes: ai-fanout.com was newly registered by Matthias Ramahi for this project.
The canonical homepage role is the AI Fanout Planner; /lab remains the secondary browser-local Answer Evidence Lab.
/methodology documents the Planner contract; /research/methodology documents the separate Evidence Lab observation method.
The sitemap is generated from Astro static routes and excludes noindex, error and API paths.
The API is closed by default and may not be publicly enabled until all CAPTCHA, atomic quota, cost and provider secrets are configured and live-tested.
Unknown paths return a real 404 and are not redirected to the homepage.
